reuse.why: The recurring-entry match is added inside the existing isWeekendOrHoliday predicate that every holiday check in the tree (getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, the app.ts handlers) already goes through.

duplication.why: A single added condition in one function; nothing is copied.

placement.why: Holiday matching stays in shared/schedules.ts and the format is documented on RecurConfig in the model types.

scope.why: Predicate, type doc comment, one test and a release note only.

maintainability.why: A one-line, commented change to the single holiday predicate, with a test covering mixed MM-DD and full-date entries across years.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; all holiday lookups use isWeekendOrHoliday
